text: Nde Yuusufu yamirnoo gollooɓe makko rimndude ngelooba musiɗɓe makko ɓen ñaametee,o waɗi etirgal laamɗo o etiraynoo ngal ka doŋngal neene gooto makko on ɓe anndaali,fii no on heddora e takko makko.Nde ɓe fokkiti yiltitagol ka maɓɓe noddoowo ewnii ɓe:Ko onon yo joomiraaɓe ngelooba roondinba ñaametee, ko on wuyɓe .
